source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public Exodus 22:1 maps to Hebrew Exod 21:37; public 22:2–31 maps to Hebrew 22:1–30. Chapters 21, 23, and 24 otherwise align.

key_decisions.decision: Retains surprising prohibition of partiality toward the poor alongside the later protection of their justice.
Chooses assistance sense of repeated azav in this difficult construction, retaining hated relationship and shared help; unloading alternative noted.
Keeps lethal judicial harm and divine refusal to justify the wicked rather than a general honesty maxim.
Keeps the specifically named enslaved woman’s son and foreigner, animal rest and refreshment’s breathing image.
Chooses cultic invocation for mention in context, retaining the stricter lips prohibition rather than explaining it away.
Preserves explicitly male obligation and Adon YHWH combination, using conventional Lord GOD typography rather than expanding to everyone.
Keeps blood, leaven prohibition, specific fat portion and morning deadline without substituting all meat.
Preserves firstfruits, sanctuary house and exact kid/mother’s-milk restriction without importing later dietary interpretation.
Keeps divine messenger as angel, guarding and prepared destination, without naming an otherwise unidentified figure.
Preserves no-pardon warning and name-within image without resolving the angel’s identity doctrinally.
Preserves all six peoples in order and explicit divine destruction rather than a neutral settlement account.
Keeps three prohibitions and emphatic destruction of cult objects, distinguishing pillars from generic idols.
Retains source shift from he will bless to I will remove instead of silently harmonizing the speaker’s grammar.
Keeps reproductive and lifespan promises in their addressed land setting, without making present-day medical guarantees.
Retains hornet image and three peoples in source order; does not settle literal insect versus figurative agent.
Keeps all four geographic markers, covenantal handing over and human expulsion; identifies seas and River selectively in note.
Keeps exclusion, stated religious rationale and trap image without contemporary political application.
